fields.notes: PROFIBUS is a fieldbus communication standard (IEC 61158 Type 3 / IEC 61784-1 CPF 3): it fixes the RS-485 (DP) / MBP (PA) physical layer, the active bus termination, the 11-bit character with even parity, the baud-rate-dependent segment length and timing, the hybrid token+master-slave MAC, the telegram family, the DP service levels, the GSD device description, and the 8-bit FCS. It does NOT impose PDK-specific SDC / floorplan constraints; the RS-485 transceiver, connector, termination and (for PA) intrinsic-safety design are board / physical-layer concerns.

electrical_channel_constraints.termination: 220 ohm active termination (390 ohm pull-up to +5 V / 390 ohm pull-down to DGND) at both segment ends
electrical_channel_constraints.character_format: 1 start + 8 data + 1 even parity + 1 stop (11 bits)
electrical_channel_constraints.pa_phy: MBP / IEC 61158-2, Manchester, bus-powered, intrinsically safe, 31.25 kbit/s

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
